#1/#4/#45/#48/#49 foreign-domestic controls stay rejected; #14/#15/#16/#25/#38 party-led controls stay rejected; #18/#20/#33/#40/#41 stay rejected.
Retain systemic/knowledge positives #8/#10/#11/#17/#19/#24/#26/#32/#35/#39/#44/#46; do not require the word India for universal knowledge.
Synthetic paired ceremony versus substantive agreement, and party criticism versus enacted policy, must differ on captured substance rather than names.

requirements.requirement: Provide a deterministic, evidence-carrying value path for institutional criticism and strategic/economic analysis. A factual law/report/action is one substance path, not the only path. Verified byline and section may support context but cannot automatically accept the article.
regressions: #21 must_read must survive the current substance veto even though score 7.5 clears the threshold.

#6/#50 must_read and #34 useful must be diagnosed separately as opaque lexical framing or missing-summary risk; evaluate bounded title, section and legitimate byline evidence without inventing arguments.
#13 lending transparency, #17 oil-price analysis and #27 fiscal federalism must remain eligible analytical reading needs.
All 8 requested-author records are tested individually: #6/#19/#21/#26/#34/#44/#46/#50. Report retention 4/8 at baseline and target each lost positive; do not use an unconditional author allowlist.
Synthetic paired same-author irrelevant/ceremonial item must reject; spoofed title-only author name must not gain verified-byline privileges.
requirements.boundary: C acceptance only. Distinct angle/novelty belongs to E; opaque arguments may require acquisition evidence, with explicit abstention counted as a miss.

requirements.requirement: Treat missing or placeholder summaries as evidence limitations. Distinguish resolvable title-led cases from unresolvable rhetoric. Output insufficient_metadata with missing evidence fields; never infer labels from prestige or silently fetch an article body.
regressions: #3/#23/#36 remain excluded from binary gold metrics; regression expects explicit insufficiency/abstention, not invented acceptance or rejection truth.
#3 has a nonempty two-word description, so a nonempty-string check cannot establish sufficient metadata.
Resolved sparse-title cases retain their owner labels in evaluation; any abstention on them is still a miss, never removed from the denominator.
Synthetic missing-description/byline/section variants emit evidence-coverage diagnostics and never trigger article or third-party-service requests.
requirements.boundary: Acquisition work is a separate handoff. C can diagnose and abstain but cannot recover absent arguments. No body acquisition, inferred summary or relabeling.

requirements.requirement: Return hard eligibility, relevance/value, substantive evidence and insufficiency independently, with stable reason codes and UTF-16 spans bound to observation IDs. Subject, novelty and ranking must not decide acceptance or be inferred from it.

#29 AI law enforcement, #31 R&D ecosystem, #44 diplomacy and #47 mining-law federalism remain accepted while D routes dominant framing.
D regression set includes every positive primary mismatch, including rejected positives; secondary tags never satisfy exact-primary accuracy.
Reordered input and repeated replay give identical output digests; labels, owner exemplars, personal state and future observations cannot enter the runner.
requirements.boundary: No D/E/F implementation. V2 has no content-type output; report owner-type acceptance patterns without claiming content-type prediction accuracy.
